name: Tinezz Blendzz
_material: Everything here is from Tinez's own Booksy profile (services, prices, durations, hours, bio, rating, reviews, photos) and his Instagram bio (@tinezzblendzz: Sensory Safe certified, Anti Broke Barbers Club ambassador, barber at @colleywoodcuts). Address is the shop's, 1210 Colley Ave, from Booksy's structured data. PHONE IS NOT PUBLISHED anywhere we can read; Booksy says it is in the app's details section. Tyler is getting it from Tinez. Booking goes to Booksy, so the page works without a phone. He said on Instagram he wants a site; nothing has been sent yet.
headline: Quality cuts. Attention to detail.
subhead: Tinez, barber at Colleywood Cuts in Ghent, Norfolk. Fades, beards, designs and kids' cuts, booked online.
servicesLede: Prices and times as Tinez lists them on Booksy. Tap what you want, then book.

services.name: Transformation
services.desc: For three months or more of growth. A full makeover, not a trim. Adding a beard trim is $15 more.

services.name: After Hours Haircut
services.desc: By text request. Starting price, depends on the service.

about: I'm Tinez (TEE-NEZ), and I've been cutting hair for 4 years. My goal is to provide quality cuts, attention to detail, and an experience that keeps you looking and feeling your best.
points: In the chair at Colleywood Cuts, 1210 Colley Ave
ctaLede: Pick your cut above and it takes you straight to Tinez's Booksy calendar. After-hours cuts are by text.
